title: Ali's Shrimp Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry with succulent shrimp and a blend of aromatic spices, served over a bed of fluffy rice.

ingredients.name: Ali's Special Sauce (soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar)

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add shrimp, stir-fry until pink and cooked through.
Add electric pepper, Arabian spice mix, and Ali's Special Sauce. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add cooked rice, scallions, and salt. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Cook time may vary based on personal preference for doneness.
Cook to an internal temperature of 145°F for the shrimp.
Serve with additional scallions and Ali's Special Sauce if desired.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve with steamed vegetables.
Reheating leftovers, add a small amount of water to prevent drying.
